diagnostics.message: The probe must be removed only after HTTP settings that may reference it are removed; otherwise deleting the probe can leave the Application Gateway configuration referencing a missing probe. Make the probe deletion depend on the HTTP settings deletion.
Frontend ports used by HTTP listeners must not be removed until those listeners have been deleted. The frontend-port deletion currently has no ordering dependency on listener deletion.

HTTP settings can reference probes, so their deletion must complete before the probe is deleted. Add the dependency in this direction; a dependency from probe deletion to HTTP-settings deletion would reverse the required destroy order.

HTTP listeners use frontend ports, so listener deletion must complete before the frontend port is deleted. The current dependency on set_frontend_port does not order deletion against delete_frontend_port.
